name: Ruhender Insert-Effekt: ein Part, der 5 s stumm ist oder dessen IFX aus ist, bekommt Punch, bis er wieder zu hören ist

changes.note: idle insert effect: the LED manager's tick, then per part the silent time, Punch after 5 s, the own effect back when heard
the LED manager registers the patch's tick instead of its own; the patch's tick calls it first

hooks.note: the patch's tick runs the LED manager's tick, then looks at the parts

startPhase.why: the LED manager registers its 40 ms timer while the device starts, now with the patch's tick
ii_tick runs every 40 ms from the start: it runs the LED manager's tick and counts; it switches only on the main screen after 5 s

ram.what: run time state: per part the ticks silent and whether it has Punch from the patch
